description: Single source of truth for which tools on the backtest MCP server (rae_runtime/mcp/server.py) are exposed to the LLM, and their least-privilege default. Intended to be consumed later by per-workflow, server-side enforcement (RAE-26).
default_rule: read/discovery -> allow; local-only write -> allow unless subsumed by a wrapper tool; external-effect write -> allow but constrained; redundant tool -> block.

access_values.allow: exposed to the LLM by default
access_values.block: not exposed to the LLM by default (may be enabled explicitly per workflow); the underlying function is unaffected

submit_backtest.contract: baseline template + caller overrides -> engine-valid .request delivered to the watched dir; returns job_name + submitted_at.
constraints: mock vs real delivery gated by USE_REAL_BACKTESTER
override keys absent from the baseline are reported in a non-blocking warnings list
submit_backtest.rationale: Core capability the agent needs to trigger a run; the write is constrained by job_name validation and the mock/real flag.

list_master_indices.contract: read-only scan of the cluster's master-indices store; returns the available data-pool versions to pass to submit_backtest.
list_master_indices.rationale: Read-only discovery, no side effects; needed before submit to pick a current data universe.

get_backtest_status.contract: poll a submitted job -> completed / rejected / timeout.
get_backtest_status.rationale: Read-only status poll; required to know when to fetch results.

get_backtest_results.contract: parse resultsTable.csv and merge schema-compatible outputs -> key performance metrics (Sharpe, drawdown, return, ...).
get_backtest_results.rationale: The metrics entry point; usable standalone (just needs job_name) to fetch results without running the whole post-processing pipeline.

list_jobs.contract: list all visible backtest jobs and their status.
list_jobs.rationale: Read-only listing; useful for the agent to orient, no side effects.

run_backtest_postprocessing.contract: convenience wrapper for a completed job: artifacts -> equity curve (if a ZQQ series is found or supplied) -> results. Auto-discovers the ZQQ file.
run_backtest_postprocessing.rationale: The single post-processing entry point for the agent; writes only under /workspace/output and calls the underlying artifact/equity/results functions directly.

get_backtest_artifacts.contract: locate artefacts under simulation-results, safely extract the ZIP if requested, copy schema files to output.
get_backtest_artifacts.rationale: Subsumed by run_backtest_postprocessing, which calls the underlying function directly. Blocking hides it from the LLM only; the wrapper is unaffected.

generate_equity_curve.contract: read a ZQQ/time-series CSV, generate an equity-curve CSV/PNG under /workspace/output.
generate_equity_curve.rationale: Not usable standalone by the LLM: its required zqq_file_path is a path the agent cannot know without first locating artefacts. run_backtest_postprocessing auto-discovers the ZQQ file and calls the underlying function directly, so blocking hides it from the LLM without affecting the pipeline.
